csv_project_name: AE for PH MU Exterior Ramp Replacement project
csv_scope_of_work: UCSF Real Estate is requesting written responses to this Qualification Packet from qualified firms to provide professional consulting services for the PH MU Exterior Ramp Replacement (PRJ-000484) project. The successful firm shall provide architectural/engineering and accessibility design services for work described under Section II, Project Scope. The selected consultant team will support the planning, design, permitting, and construction administration efforts associated with accessibility improvements to the existing exterior ramp serving Millberry Union at the UCSF Parnassus Heights campus
